name: Default
shortDescription: Self-hosted live streaming server with a web UI that pulls network video sources, serves HLS to a built-in player and restreams to YouTube, Twitch and other RTMP/SRT targets.

alerts.message: Open https://<your-domain>/ui and log in as admin with the generated CORE_API_AUTH_PASSWORD from the environment; login settings are locked to these variables in the UI.
Only HTTP is routed. RTMP (1935/tcp) and SRT (6000/udp) ingest from OBS or encoders needs those ports published separately; network sources such as RTSP or HLS cameras work without them.
